$description: Every real motion pattern observed in the source: scroll-reveal, canvas orbital marks, marquee, caret blink, accordion transitions. No pattern here is invented — each cites the file that implements it.
measuredFrom: src/components/useInView.jsx, src/index.css:44-84, src/components/Closing.jsx, src/pages/Careers.jsx, src/components/Caret.jsx, src/pages/ChatForMac.jsx, PROCESS.md §9

scroll-reveal.mechanism: IntersectionObserver (threshold 0.12, rootMargin '0px 0px -8% 0px') paired with a rAF-throttled scroll/resize fallback check so a fast scroll or restored scroll position can't leave a section permanently invisible
usedBy: Reveal wrapper in src/components/Shared.jsx (PerfectFor, Faq, BenchStrip, ModelCards, ClosingBand), src/pages/AboutUs.jsx, src/pages/ChatForMac.jsx, src/pages/Blog.jsx post cards, src/pages/ConversionToolkit.jsx, src/pages/InferenceRuntime.jsx

canvas-orbital-mark.mechanism: requestAnimationFrame canvas draw loop drawing 18-26 concentric ellipses rotating over time, respecting prefers-reduced-motion (loop simply does not advance t)
canvas-orbital-mark.citation: src/components/Closing.jsx:5-33 (240px Orb, 26 ellipses), src/pages/Careers.jsx:14-42 (200px Mark, 18 ellipses)
canvas-orbital-mark.reducedMotionFallback: loop checks window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') and never calls requestAnimationFrame again after the first frame, so the mark renders as a single static frame
canvas-orbital-mark.note: PROCESS.md §10: these illustrations were reconstructed from measured geometry / a reference capture, not copied from Mirai Labs' original artwork — explicitly a neutral placeholder, not real brand art.

marquee.reducedMotionFallback: global @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rule collapses all animation-duration to 0.001ms (src/index.css:80-86)

terminal-caret-blink.mechanism: JS-toggled opacity (NOT a CSS animation) at ~530ms cadence, transition: opacity 0.08s ease
terminal-caret-blink.reducedMotionFallback: component-level; inherits the global transition-duration override

rise-fade.mechanism: CSS keyframe used for hero chat-row entrance, opacity 0.35s + transform 0.35s on cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)

accordion-expand.mechanism: CSS grid-template-rows transition between '0fr' and '1fr'/explicit px, 0.2-0.3s ease-out
accordion-expand.citation: src/components/Shared.jsx Faq (0.2s ease-out), src/pages/InferenceRuntime.jsx FEATURES accordion (0.3s)

hover-only.mechanism: color/opacity transition on :hover, no entry animation, no count-up — explicitly measured against the original as NOT animating on scroll/mount
hover-only.citation: src/pages/Metrics.jsx Chart component comment: 'no entry animation, no count-up, hover shade only (0.15s)'; src/components/Shared.jsx BarTip comment: 'NO entry animation — it simply shows and hides'
hover-only.reducedMotionFallback: not applicable — already a static, non-looping transition under 0.2s

notPresent.note: The original site declares a service-convergence-pulse keyframe and applies it to nothing on any nav page, and has no wire-flow keyframe at all (the converging wires are SMIL <animate stroke-dashoffset>, dur 3.2s, staggered 0.35s begin, implemented in AppGrid.jsx). Recorded here so a generator does not invent a CSS keyframe of that name.
